steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Commercialisation: The involvement of businesses and corporations in sport for financial gain. Sport is treated as a product to be marketed, sponsored and sold. Commercialisation has transformed modern sport from amateur participation into a multi-billion-pound global industry. | The Golden Triangle: The interdependent relationship between sport, media and sponsorship. Each element supports and depends on the other two, creating a cycle of mutual benefit that drives commercialisation. | Balanced View: Commercialisation has transformed sport, bringing enormous financial investment and global exposure. steps.body: Describe the golden triangle and explain how each element depends on the other two. | Explain two positive and two negative impacts of commercialisation on performers. | How has social media changed the relationship between sport and sponsorship?
